summary: macOS 1.0.77: two writes (23 channels, then 1 channel) failed with "Pipe error" ~6 s after the write started (channel preparation), before the erase changed anything; the following read matched the earlier image except the edit. Transport diverged from dmrconfig/QDMR: download/upload-idle treated as ready instead of aborted to dfuIDLE, no programming-mode re-entry before erase, 2 s timeouts, and any status stall after an erase was fatal (QDMR ignores those errors).
title: Write stops with libusb "Pipe error" (USB stall) before any erase
